## New Strategic Tools

Beginning this week, countries may use two additional policy tools:

- Trade Agreements
- FX Intervention

### Trade Agreement Options

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| Bilateral | Two countries expand trade or reduce barriers |
| Multilateral / Open | Three or more countries cooperate in a trade framework |
| Strategic Goods | Cooperation in critical goods such as energy or food |

Countries may propose **one agreement per round**. Agreements must be accepted by all participating countries.

### FX Intervention

Countries may intervene in currency markets through their central bank.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| Support Currency | Central bank buys domestic currency |
| Weaken Currency | Central bank sells domestic currency |
| No Intervention | Market determines exchange rate |

::: {.callout-note}
Intervention works best when combined with credible policy such as monetary tightening.
:::
